Talent Acquisition Partner · 斯凯孚(中国)有限公司
聊一聊
职位介绍
Job Responsibilities:

As a global leader in bearing and rotating machinery condition monitoring, SKF is committed to creating exceptional value for customers through cutting-edge predictive maintenance technologies. This role will be deeply embedded in our core algorithm team, focusing on leveraging advanced machine learning technologies to solve world-class engineering challenges such as rotating machinery fault diagnosis, anomaly detection, and remaining useful life (RUL) prediction. Join us to design and implement more intelligent SKF predictive maintenance algorithm solutions.

Job Requirements:

 ● Education: Master’s degree or above in Computer Science, Artificial Intelligence, Applied Mathematics, Automation, Mechanical Engineering, or a related field.
 ● Familiar with signal analysis and processing methods, with a deep understanding of time-series forecasting, anomaly detection, and supervised/unsupervised learning algorithms.
 ● Hands-on project experience in predictive maintenance or PHM (Prognostics and Health Management) is preferred; experience with complete project cases covering “algorithm design–model training–deployment implementation,” and the ability to independently address industrial challenges such as small-sample learning and complex background interference are preferred.
 ● Proficient in Python and skilled in mainstream deep learning frameworks such as PyTorch, TensorFlow, and DeepSpeed.
 ● Familiar with SQL and NoSQL database operations; understanding of big data processing frameworks such as Spark and Kafka is preferred.
 ● Strong coding standards, with familiarity with Git, Docker, CI/CD processes, and model deployment tools such as ONNX and TensorRT.
 ● Familiarity with MLOps toolchains such as MLflow, Kubeflow, and Airflow, and experience in full model lifecycle management are preferred.
 ● Good English reading and writing skills, with the ability to read English technical documentation fluently and collaborate with international teams.
 ● Excellent logical thinking and cross-functional communication skills.

其他信息
行业要求：全部行业
所属部门：工业技术
公司简介
斯凯孚集团的愿景是可靠运转的世界，我们提供的解决方案减少了摩擦和二氧化碳排放，同时延长了机器正常的运行时间，提高设备性能。斯凯孚提供旋转轴相关的产品和服务，包括轴承、密封、润滑管理、人工智能和无线状态检测。斯凯孚中国于1912年进入中国，现演变为一家知识、技术和数据驱动，以交付可靠运转为使命的公司。
